rules: All 67 frozen candidates remain in the output. Hospital facts without an existing matched candidate are audit-visible and do not create candidates.
Collection time controls episode alignment. Report time and unspecified source_time do not replace it. Exact hour offsets remain audit fields.
Same patient and exact/alias organism identity are required. Generic HSV/HHV-6 labels remain group context.
A source assertion is not a newly adjudicated clinical diagnosis. Only deterministic source checks are marked complete.
Source review_required/unusable flags are preserved. Composite unaligned results cannot be repaired by guessing.
Serology is not molecular detection or active replication. Numeric CMV-VL data remain measurements and do not automatically establish activity or disease.
A generic Non-panel Molecular Test label does not identify PCR/qPCR. Missing assay method remains unknown.
Different technical branches of one mNGS specimen share one biological evidence group.
Repeated source copies are retained as provenance references to one fact and cannot create independent corroboration.
Blood-only evidence never establishes pulmonary disease. An explicit independent respiratory specimen can corroborate detection without proving disease.
No probable/proven pulmonary disease claims are generated from keyword matches. Organ attribution policy remains unchanged.
Missing, unknown, negative, historical and outside-window are distinct states.
